title: Scene editor: story map and placement
caption: Stage 3 of the scene editor. The scene list is now the story map's outline: pick a day, and each place lists the scenes that start there, how they start and when. The Scene tab says when a scene plays as one sentence, and each part of it opens a picker. The map of a day shows a place's scenes by time of day with the choices and jumps between them, and a scene is dragged to another time (a private one also to another place or day). New public scenes come from three templates. Every capture here is of public scenes outside private mode.

sections.title: The list and the sentence
sections.caption: Day 1, Station security. Each scene says how it starts; the Scene tab says when it plays, and the parts in boxes are the pickers.
